programs.title: Europe's Wild Marvels
programs.desc: Nat Geo Wild explores the beauty and ferocity of the animal kingdom, offering an intimate look at the world’s most incredible creatures in their habitats.

programs.title: America's National Parks
programs.desc: The creators of the series discover the majesty of the most interesting national parks located in the USA.They attract millions of tourists from all over the world.You can admire breathtaking landscapes from popular viewpoints.Viewers will see the beauty of eight national parks from a less obvious perspective.They will move not only to the famous Grand Canyon, but also to less familiar places.They will learn about the guards' favorite places and what makes each of these protected areas so special.They will also see what animals live in these places and what their life is like in the bosom of nature.The latest technologies were used to produce the series, including:drones and cameras with telephoto lenses.

programs.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programs.desc:
For two years, National Geographic explorer Bertie Gregory closely studied the tight-knit communities of some of the world's most intelligent penguins.He documented behaviors and situations that had previously been difficult to capture on camera.The series proves that penguins are much closer to humans than was previously known.These unique flightless birds are brave and adventurous, and at the same time value family bonds and friendship.Thanks to their ingenuity, they can survive in the most extreme conditions
20 years have passed since the premiere of the Oscar-winning "March of the Penguins".The three-part documentary series rediscovers the world of the inhabitants of the most hostile regions of the world.Today, groundbreaking technologies and scientific work allow us to look at flightless birds from a previously unavailable perspective.One of the guides to the penguin kingdom is Bertie Gregory, who camped with the team near the emperor penguin colony in Antarctica.The superhuman effort resulted in the recording of scenes that humans had never seen before.The most important thing is family. The first heroes of the bird saga are the largest representatives of the family - emperor penguins.For the first time, a television crew recorded an astonishing acrobatic display with their participation: hundreds of chicks of this species jumping from a 50-meter cliff into the icy ocean.Researchers also looked at the bonds between families, friends and strangers.In extreme conditions, social skills mean the difference between life and death.The cameras also included rockhopper, gentoo and golden-crested penguins.Filmmakers have discovered surprising behaviors of animals that can cooperate, take risks and even rebel.

programs.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations 3
programs.desc: Vernard and Terrence run a veterinary clinic in Georgia where they help animals of many species.Patients and their caregivers appreciate the commitment with which they approach each case.

programs.title: Australia's Wild Woodlands
programs.desc: Eucalyptus forests are a refuge for parrots and platypuses.These vast areas are also inhabited by tree kangaroos.It turns out that the future of the ancient antipodean ecosystem is uncertain.

programs.title: Red Sea: Evolution's Magic Garden
programs.desc: The Red Sea boasts one of the largest coral reefs in the world, full of diverse species.The nearby deserts, although seemingly unfriendly, are also teeming with life.

programs.title: Deep Sea Dwellers
programs.desc: Cephalopods are an inspiration for creators of special effects in cinema.They resemble visitors from a distant galaxy, even though they have inhabited Earth for millions of years.They have three hearts.

programs.title: Wildes Südafrika - Der 8. Kontinent
programs.desc: South Africa, like the entire continent, is very diverse.This is a place where cold-loving penguins live alongside ostriches that live in sandy areas.Sea snails and lively chameleons also thrive in this climate.South Africa has distinctive geographical features as well as extreme climatic conditions.Wild animals are exposed to constant changes in living conditions.On the west coast you can meet predatory sea lions that specialize in hunting young Cape boobies;in the south, giant crocodiles, lions and deer, and inland - elephants.

programs.title: Underdogs
programs.desc: The creators of the National Geographic documentary series set themselves the goal of showing the natural world from a new perspective.They invited actor Ryan Reynolds to cooperate, who is the narrator in the original language version.This extraordinary story will not include heroes such as fast cheetahs, brave lions or eagle-eyed birds of prey.The main role will be played by animals that seem to be failures.It turns out that their weaknesses and apparent defects have enormous potential.Stunning wildlife photography and music by Harry Gregson-Williams ("Shrek," "The Martian") set the backdrop for the adventures of freaks and outcasts of the fauna kingdom who have developed effective survival techniques, resilience and surprising instincts.Among them is the pistol shrimp, which can shoot hot water bubbles.Some species of frogs have superpowers - they become invisible.The anglerfish, on the other hand, is a master of camouflage.The next episodes will feature terrible parents and poor seducers.Cameras will follow the peculiarities of the world of meerkats, sloths, macaques, proboscis monkeys, mosquitoes and snails.There will be plenty of humor and surprising plot twists.

programs.title: Alaska's Grizzly Gauntlet
programs.desc: Prince William Sound is home to black bears.Three thousand individuals live there, and over 100,000 in the entire territory of Alaska.Survivalist Les Stroud will take a closer look at them, and what's more, he will come face to face with them.However, before he decides to meet, he must learn more about the habits of the subjects of his research.He will be helped by someone who knows everything about the local flora and fauna.Stroud's guide spent decades observing black bears.Thanks to it, the traveler will learn what dangers he may encounter after crossing the borders of the kingdom of these predators.The expedition begins when they are preparing for the arrival of winter.They need to increase their weight because the additional protective layer is useful in hostile weather conditions.Bears are looking for food, but if they choose the wrong place, they are in serious danger.First of all, they must be vigilant - every rustle means that an unwanted companion has appeared.Viewers will see how predators deal with them.It is also worth mentioning that these animals want to be left in peace wherever they are.This is why Stroud does not enter their lairs, because a confrontation may prove painful.
